name: Amazon Madison Mega Site

timeline.event: Generators and chillers still being installed on buildings 1-5.
Buildings 1-5 are operational, based on roofs being completed 5 months ago and generators being installed by 2025-04-10.
Confirmation that five buildings are fully equipped with cooling and backup generators.
Buildings 6 and 7 roof completed. Building 8 roof nearly completed. Building 9 roof half way up. No new operational buildings.
Buildings 6 and 7 operational, estimated from roofs having been completed 9 months ago (similar timeline to AWS buildings at New Carlisle in 2025).

Buildings 8-12 are operational. In June of 2026 only a faint outline of buildings 10,11 and 12 is visible, estimating construction completion to be the end of 2027, alligning with [expected completion by 2027](https://www.datacenterdynamics

sources.quote: Amazon Madison Mega Site: current power 284 MW; owner Amazon.

explain: Amazon Madison Mega Site is an operating AI data center in Canton, MS, owned by amazon. Epoch AI estimates it draws 284 MW today and 819 MW when finished.
